* NPC empires always want to refresh their truces until the next AI cycle can update this desire properly.
* Restart squadrons.
* News

* Add-Ons 1.4: No amnesty for OCV players - they lost!
* Infamy decay is set in ZH.Setup.Variables. 90% of infamy is removed.
* Amnesty clears at least 1 infamy.
* Terracorp defines new secret Xenon progress goals.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Fixed randomization not being set!
